name.fr-FR: De l’élection et de la nomination des évêques
name.en-US: On the Election and Nomination of Bishops
name.pt-BR: Da eleição e da nomeação dos bispos

description.fr-FR: Premier livre de Prosper Guéranger (1831), écrit au Mans après la Révolution de 1830 : le ministère de l’élection, le rôle du clergé et du peuple, les devoirs et les limites du prince chrétien, les investitures, les réserves, la Pragmatique Sanction, le Concordat de 1516 et leurs conséquences, avec une exhortation aux évêques de France. Les paragraphes explicatifs de Dom Delatte qui précèdent le texte sont omis.
description.en-US: Prosper Guéranger’s first book (1831), written at Le Mans after the Revolution of 1830: the ministry of election, the role of clergy and people, the duties and limits of the Christian prince, investitures, reservations, the Pragmatic Sanction, the Concordat of 1516 and its consequences, with an exhortation to the bishops of France. Dom Delatte’s explanatory paragraphs that precede the text are left out.
description.pt-BR: O primeiro livro de Prosper Guéranger (1831), escrito em Le Mans após a Revolução de 1830: o ministério da eleição, o papel do clero e do povo, os deveres e limites do príncipe cristão, as investiduras, as reservas, a Pragmática Sanção, a Concordata de 1516 e suas consequências, com uma exortação aos bispos da França. Os parágrafos explicativos de Dom Delatte que precedem o texto foram omitidos.

fr-FR.editor: Au Mans (1831), as reproduced in Dom Delatte’s Dom Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (Paris, 1910)

sources.edition: De l’élection et de la nomination des évêques, Le Mans, 1831 (domgueranger.net HTML transcription, 271 notes)
sources.description: Complete text of the twenty chapters as reproduced on the site; headnote paragraphs in italics omitted.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; text first published in his lifetime or by 1931.
